name: Brew What You Got
tagline: Cafe-quality drink recipes built from the gear and beans you already own
description: List the coffee machine you own, the beans in the cupboard, the milk in the fridge and whatever syrups or spices are on the shelf, and it replies with cafe-style drinks you can pull off right now. The constraint is the point: no shopping run and no substitutions you do not have.
author: Ebatez_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
